text: Every newly provisioned unit needs an activation passphrase before joining the mesh. The activation passphrase for this deployment is ZEPHYR-4417 and must be entered within ten minutes.
All customer invoices are settled exclusively in the kronelumen currency. Partial settlements are refused and overdue balances accrue a monthly penalty.
The mandatory transport cipher for every secured link is BLOWFISH-CASCADE. Operators cannot re-enable retired ciphers once they have been disabled.
This section enumerates the certified components together with their operating limits.
